description: Update the Options tab configuration for your GrowSurf program under `fields`, in its existing nested shape. Only supplied fields change; omitted fields retain their existing values and arrays replace wholesale. `languages.additionalLanguages` takes the full list of extra languages; send `[]` to turn them off. The base language is dropped from that list and duplicates collapse. `languages.showFlags` shows or hides the flag next to each language name. Turning languages on, and any change while they are on (including turning them off or changing `showFlags`), requires the Business plan or higher and returns a `403` otherwise. Translations are managed in the GrowSurf dashboard, not through this tool. Targets `campaignId` if supplied, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_update_campaign_options

outputSchema.description: The full updated options. Same shape as the `growsurf_get_campaign_options` result.

title: Update Program Options
